record.paper_title: New results and open problems on Toeplitz operators in Bergman spaces
record.original_question: Let a be a distributional symbol in W^{-m,∞}_ν that already has a representation a = ∑_{α \le m} (-1)^{|α|} D^α b_α with each weighted coefficient b_α ν^{-|α|} continuous on the disk. Does it then follow that the Berezin transform ṽa is continuous on the disk? The paper states that a positive answer would help develop Fredholm theory for Toeplitz operators with distributional symbols.

evidence.quote: Problem 9. If a ∈ W−m,∞ν is of the form (6.1) with bαν−|α| ∈ C(D), does if follow that ṽa ∈ C(D)? A positive answer would be useful in the study of Fredholm properties of Toeplitz operators with distributional symbols.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $\mathbb{D}=\{z\in\mathbb{C}:|z|<1\}$ be the open unit disk and, for $\nu>-1$, let $dA_\nu(z)=(\nu+1)(1-|z|^2)^\nu\,dA(z)/\pi$ denote the standard weighted area measure on $\mathbb{D}$. For an integer $m\ge 0$, define the weighted Sobolev-type space $W^{-m,\infty}_\nu$ as the space of distributions on $\mathbb{D}$ that admit a representation
$$a=\sum_{|\alpha|\le m}(-1)^{|\alpha|}D^{\alpha}b_\alpha,$$
where each $b_\alpha\in L^\infty_{\mathrm{loc}}(\mathbb{D})$ satisfies $b_\alpha(z)(1-|z|^2)^{-|\alpha|}\in L^\infty(\mathbb{D},dA_\nu)$, and $D^\alpha$ denotes a (real) partial derivative of order $|\alpha|$ in distributional sense.

For the normalized reproducing kernel of the weighted Bergman space $A^2_\nu(\mathbb{D})$,
$$k_z(w)=\frac{(1-|z|^2)^{(\nu+2)/2}}{(1-\bar z w)^{\nu+2}},\qquad z,w\in\mathbb{D},$$
the Berezin transform of $a\in W^{-m,\infty}_\nu$ is defined (via duality) by
$$\tilde a(z)=\langle a,\,|k_z|^2\rangle,\qquad z\in\mathbb{D}.$$

Suppose $a\in W^{-m,\infty}_\nu$ admits a representation as above in which, for every multi-index $\alpha$ with $|\alpha|\le m$, the function $z\mapsto b_\alpha(z)(1-|z|^2)^{-|\alpha|}$ is continuous on $\mathbb{D}$.

Question: Must the Berezin transform $\tilde a$ then be continuous on $\mathbb{D}$?
artifact.status_search_result: A literature search on Toeplitz operators with distributional symbols on Bergman spaces and the Berezin transform on $W^{-m,\infty}_\nu$ did not produce a definitive resolution of this continuity question. Related work develops boundedness, compactness, and trace-class results for Toeplitz operators with distributional/singular symbols and uses Berezin-transform criteria, but no source explicitly settles the specific continuity statement under the stated hypothesis on the coefficients $b_\alpha\nu^{-|\alpha|}$.

status_evidence.title: Toeplitz operators with distributional symbols on Bergman spaces
status_evidence.snippet: Defines and studies Toeplitz operators with distributional symbols in W^{-m,infty}_nu on the Bergman space of the unit disk.
status_evidence.claim: Provides the framework of distributional symbols and Berezin transform used in the question, without resolving the specific continuity problem.

status_evidence.title: Trace Class Toeplitz Operators with Singular Symbols
status_evidence.snippet: Sufficient conditions for trace-class Toeplitz operators with distributional symbols; introduces Berezin transform of distributions for a trace formula.
status_evidence.claim: Related developments on Berezin transform of distributional symbols, but does not address continuity of $\tilde a$ under the stated hypothesis.

status_evidence.title: New results and open problems on Toeplitz operators in Bergman spaces (PDF)
status_evidence.snippet: Lists open problems concerning continuity, boundedness, and Fredholm properties of Toeplitz operators with distributional symbols.
status_evidence.claim: Indicates the question is posed as an open problem in the area; no resolution found.
